_comment: RP2350-Zero A/B image slots for the over-the-link update (sd-4k1.3). Written ONCE over USB with picotool; the exact commands live in .claude/rules/build-test-deploy.md. A is partition 0 and B links to it -- src/rp2350_motion/main.cpp BootromSlot::resolve assumes exactly that pairing and reports kFlashDetailNoSlot for anything else. 2016K each leaves the first sectors for the partition table itself on a 4 MB part.
